Lancement de timbres postaux pour sensib: Launch of postage stamps to raise awareness against drug abuse
ALGER, 27/06/2026 — Le ministre de la Po: ALGER, 06/27/2026 — The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, in the presence of officials from the security and health sectors, officially launched two new postage stamps dedicated to the International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking, celebrated every year on June 26. These philatelic issues, carried out in collaboration with the National Post Office (ONP), aim to strengthen the awareness of Algerian citizens regarding the dangers of illicit substances and to mobilize all national stakeholders against this scourge. The stamps, available in post offices across all wilayas, display clear messages and striking visuals highlighting the health, social, and security risks associated with drug consumption and trafficking.
Lors de la cérémonie, le ministre a soul: During the ceremony, the minister emphasized that this initiative is part of the government's ongoing efforts to strengthen prevention and enforcement in this area. He also recalled Algeria's commitment to respecting international conventions, notably the 1961 Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs and the 1988 Convention against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances. The two stamps, issued in a limited series, will be available for purchase until December 31, 2026, with a face value of fifty Algerian dinars (50 DA) each.
Cette initiative philatélique s'ajoute a: This philatelic initiative adds to the structural measures implemented by the Algerian authorities to combat the trafficking and use of illicit substances. In 2025, Algerian security services seized more than 12 tons of cannabis and 2.5 tons of synthetic drugs across the country, according to data from the Ministry of the Interior. These figures, although down by 15% compared to 2024, remain concerning and require a multidimensional approach, combining prevention, education, and enforcement. Postage stamps, by reaching the entire population via an accessible and daily channel, play a key role in spreading awareness messages.
Sur le plan économique, cette émission c: Economically, this issue helps boost the Algerian postal sector, which is already undergoing modernization. In 2025, the turnover of the National Post Office (ONP) reached 12 billion Algerian dinars, with an 8% growth compared to 2024, driven notably by the increase in digital and philatelic services. Commemorative stamps also generate additional revenue for the state, while serving as a medium for social and health causes of national scale.
